tagline: Schedule Trello sprint calls and post Zoom meeting summaries back to cards
metaTitle: Trello Zoom Integration: Sprint Calls and Meeting Summaries
metaDescription: Run sprint calls straight from your Trello board. GAIA books a Zoom kickoff when a card changes stage and posts the summary to it. See the setup steps.
intro:
Sprint boards drive the rhythm of project work, but much of that work is coordinated in Zoom meetings — sprint planning calls, card review sessions, retrospectives. Without automation, teams manually schedule meetings that should be triggered by board events, and the action items discussed on those calls never find their way back into cards without someone taking detailed notes and manually creating cards afterward.

GAIA connects Trello and Zoom so meetings are scheduled automatically at the right board stage and meeting outcomes flow back into the board immediately after each call. When a sprint list is fully populated and ready to start, GAIA schedules the sprint kickoff call. When the call ends, GAIA posts the meeting summary to the board and creates cards from action items extracted from the transcript.

This integration is built for agile teams, project managers, and any group that runs structured board reviews on video calls and needs meeting outcomes to live inside Trello where the actual work is tracked.

useCases.title: Schedule sprint kickoff calls from board stage changes
useCases.description: When a board moves to a new sprint stage or a sprint list is populated, GAIA schedules a Zoom kickoff call with the team, sends calendar invites, and attaches the meeting link to the board.

useCases.title: Post Zoom meeting summaries to Trello cards
useCases.description: After a call associated with a board, GAIA generates a meeting summary from the transcript and posts it as a comment on the relevant card, creating a permanent discussion record.

useCases.title: Create Trello cards from Zoom action items
useCases.description: GAIA analyzes call transcripts for action items and creates corresponding cards in the appropriate list, with the action item as the card title and the responsible person as the assignee.

useCases.title: Sprint retrospective scheduling
useCases.description: When all cards in a sprint list are completed, GAIA schedules a retrospective call with the team and attaches a retrospective summary template to the board for preparation.

useCases.title: Card review sessions for blocked items
useCases.description: When multiple cards are flagged as blocked, GAIA schedules an unblocking session with the relevant card owners and posts a pre-meeting agenda to the board with all blocked cards listed.

howItWorks.step: Connect Trello and Zoom to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Trello boards and Zoom account. Link your calendar so GAIA can schedule meetings that fit the team's availability.

howItWorks.step: Configure board events that trigger meetings
howItWorks.description: Define which board states or list events should trigger meetings, who should be invited, and when the meeting should be scheduled relative to the board event.

howItWorks.step: GAIA schedules calls and captures outcomes
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors the board for trigger events, schedules the meetings, and after each call posts summaries and action item cards back to the board automatically.

faqs.question: Can GAIA schedule a call directly from a Trello card comment?
faqs.answer: Yes. Mention GAIA in a card comment asking for a meeting, and it will schedule a video call with the card members, check calendar availability, and post the meeting link back to the card.

faqs.question: Does GAIA require Zoom cloud recording for meeting summaries?
faqs.answer: Transcription or cloud recording must be enabled on the meeting for GAIA to generate summaries. GAIA accesses the transcript after the meeting ends and generates a structured summary.

faqs.question: Can GAIA create recurring sprint meetings based on sprint cycles?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can schedule recurring sprint calls based on your board's sprint cadence, automatically adding the meeting link to the board and updating the invite as team membership changes.
